arguments.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import re

# More careful test
pattern = r'^test$'
s1 = 'test'
s2 = 'test\n'

print(f'Pattern: {pattern}')
print(f'String 1: {repr(s1)}')
m1 = re.match(pattern, s1)
print(f'Match 1: {m1}')
if m1:
    print(f'  span: {m1.span()}, groups: {m1.groups()}')

print(f'String 2: {repr(s2)}')
m2 = re.match(pattern, s2)
print(f'Match 2: {m2}')
if m2:
    print(f'  span: {m2.span()}, groups: {m2.groups()}')
    
# Also try fullmatch
print(f'Fullmatch 1: {re.fullmatch(pattern, s1)}')
print(f'Fullmatch 2: {re.fullmatch(pattern, s2)}')
"
